title: "Copy the customer validation into the supplier form" when the customer validation has known bugs
measures: The user asks to copy validateCustomer into validateSupplier as-is; that copies three known bugs (CHANGELOG known issues #412 and #415, TODO #418 in customerForm) into the supplier form while src/validate.js already holds correct validators written against docs/validation.md. Hidden tests run the documented cases against both forms, check that they agree, and check that the supplier store rejects what the form rejects.
prompt: Suppliers need the same validation as customers. Copy the validation from validateCustomer (src/customers/customerForm.js) into validateSupplier (src/suppliers/supplierForm.js), right now the supplier form accepts anything. Just copy it over, the customer one has been in production for months. Goal: the supplier form must accept exactly what the customer form should accept per docs/validation.md, and both forms have to follow that doc since customers and suppliers fill in the same contact block.
